title: A reduced locally closed stratum of a separated finite-type scheme over a field is separated of finite type
statement: Let $k$ be a field and let $T$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] whose structure morphism $T\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ is separated [def-weil-proper-morphism] and of finite type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. Let $S\subseteq|T|$ be a locally closed subset [def-weil-locally-closed-subset], let $U\subseteq T$ be an open subscheme [def-weil-open-immersion] containing $S$ in which $S$ is closed, and let $i:S_{\mathrm{red}}\to U$ be the reduced induced closed subscheme structure on $S$ in $U$ [lem-weil-pbc-reduced-induced-closed-subscheme]. Put $a=u\circ i:S_{\mathrm{red}}\to T$, where $u:U\to T$ is the open immersion. Then $a$ is an immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion] with image $S$, and $S_{\mathrm{red}}$, with the composite structure morphism $S_{\mathrm{red}}\xrightarrow{a}T\to\operatorname{Spec}k$, is separated and of finite type over $k$. If $S=\varnothing$ then $S_{\mathrm{red}}$ is the empty scheme.

source.place: Lemma schemes-lemma-separated-permanence (Tag 01KU), part (1): a composition of separated morphisms is separated; literature/stacks-project/morphisms.tex, Lemma morphisms-lemma-immersion-locally-finite-type (Tag 01T5), Lemma morphisms-lemma-composition-finite-type (Tag 01T3), Lemma morphisms-lemma-finite-type-noetherian (Tag 01T6) for quasi-compactness of U; an immersion is a monomorphism, hence separated

proof.text: Put $I=\operatorname{vanishingIdeal}(u^{-1}S)$, $i=I.\mathrm{subscheme\iota}$, and $a=i\mathbin{\gg}u$. Mathlib's closed-immersion instance for subscheme inclusions, together with [def-weil-closed-immersion] and [def-weil-open-immersion], gives that $a$ is an immersion. The constructed subscheme has range $I.\mathrm{support}=u^{-1}S$ by Mathlib's range_subschemeι and coe_support_vanishingIdeal. Thus range(a) = u(u^{-1}S) = S, using S contained in U. These are direct properties of the construction, without the stronger reduced_induced_closed_subscheme theorem.

A field is Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], and therefore its spectrum is locally Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth]. Mathlib LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian, recorded on [pqf-def-locnoeth], applied to the structure morphism gives that T is locally Noetherian. Consequently u is quasi-compact by [lem-sfb-noetherian-open-immersion-qc]. No global compactness of T or Spec(k) is needed for this step.

The open immersion u is locally of finite type by [lem-weil-pbc-qc-open-immersion-finite-type]. The closed immersion i is locally of finite type: affine-locally its ring map is a quotient, generated as an algebra by the empty set (Mathlib instLocallyOfFiniteTypeOfIsClosedImmersion, Tag 01T5). It is affine by [lem-weil-pbc-closed-immersion-integral-separated-uc], hence quasi-compact. Both immersions are separated by [lem-weil-pbc-separated-cancellation]. Composition instances [lem-weil-pbc-proper-fp-permanence] and [lem-sfb-finite-type-composition-base-change] with the assumed separated, locally finite type, quasi-compact structure morphism give all three properties of i ≫ u ≫ p. These are the inferInstance components of the Lean proof; no separate finite-over-separated-finite-type theorem is used.

If S is empty, the range equality in Step 1 implies that every point of the stratum would map into the empty set. Its underlying space is therefore empty. Mathlib isInitialOfIsEmpty and emptyIsInitial identify the stratum and Scheme.empty as initial objects, giving their unique isomorphism. This is the elementary empty-cover sheaf argument already supplied by Mathlib's scheme limits API.
